en.title: The Rusted Steam Gravestone and the Pages of the Ice Castle
en.premise: In a world choked by thick clouds and stained with soot, my days are spent scavenging for scrap. One day, tucked away in a corner of the ruins, I discover a map to an unknown bookstore and a clue leading to the 'Ice Castle'—a place where the records of a lost civilization are said to slumber. With only a trickle of fuel left, a rusted prosthetic arm, and a worn-out steam gun, I set out on a journey to find the frozen memories of brass.

zh.title: 生锈的蒸汽墓碑与冰之城的篇章
zh.premise: 在被厚重云层笼罩、满是煤烟的世界里，我每天过着搜寻废料的生活。直到某一天，我在废墟的一角发现了一张无主古书店的地图，以及通往传说中沉睡着失落文明记录的“冰之城”的线索。燃料所剩无几，我带着生锈的义肢和用旧了的蒸汽枪，踏上了寻找冰封黄铜记忆的旅程。
